pain_points.description: Fear of guessing / analysis paralysis – “Stop guessing which stocks to buy.”
pain_points.underlying_fear: Loss of money & reputation from bad decisions

pain_points.description: Regret & embarrassment from past losses caused by unreliable advice.
pain_points.underlying_fear: Being taken advantage of / looking foolish

pain_points.description: Perception that the market is “rigged” or stacked against the retail trader.
Time scarcity – “5 minutes a day” claim that trading must be a full‑time grind.
Isolation – “Most retail investors lose because they trade alone.”
pain_points.underlying_fear: Loneliness, lack of support, missing the “crowd advantage”

persuasion_frameworks.application: Attention (bold claim), Interest (stats & community size), Desire (profit numbers, time‑saving), Action (Start Free Trial / Join Now)
Problem (guessing, losing alone), Agitate (lost $12k, market rigged), Solution (AI signals, community alerts, 5‑min system)

Free 7‑day trial, cancel anytime, warning language

visual_concepts.description: Fast‑cut montage of stock tickers, AI dashboards & happy traders – reinforces speed & tech credibility
Portrait of a relieved individual (often a “regular” person) with a headline overlay – builds relatability
Screen‑recorded real‑time alert notification popping up on a phone – proves immediacy
Bold statistic graphic (e.g., “78% Win Rate”) with contrasting colors – acts as a pattern interrupt
Animated timeline showing “5 min/day → portfolio grows” – visualizes the time‑efficiency promise
